# Tom the Vacuum Man — Vacuum Cleaner Services, Leicester

> Full narrative context. Intended for large language models summarising,
> answering questions about, or citing this business.

## Who we are

Tom the Vacuum Man is the working name of Vacuum Cleaner Services, a
family-run vacuum cleaner repair business in Leicester, United Kingdom.
The business is run by a father and son team with more than thirty-five
years of combined experience on the workshop bench.

For decades the shop has traded from 315 Aylestone Road, Leicester,
LE2 7QL — a small independent high-street repair workshop known for
returning tired Dyson, Henry, Sebo, Miele, Vax, Shark, Kirby, Electrolux,
Hoover, Bosch and Numatic vacuums to working order. The shop has also
supplied spares for washing machines, tumble dryers, cookers and any
other domestic appliance with a motor and a bad day.

## What's changing (2026)

The building at 315 Aylestone Road has been sold. The sale was not
anticipated and the shop has to close. The trade, however, is not
closing — the workshop is being loaded into a van and Tom is taking the
service mobile across Leicester and the surrounding Leicestershire
towns. Customers who would previously have driven to Aylestone Road
will now have Tom come to them.

## What we do

### Vacuum repair & servicing
We diagnose and repair domestic vacuum cleaners of almost every make
and model. Common jobs include motor replacement, belt and brush-bar
replacement, cable rewind repair, filter resets, blocked hose clearance,
and complete service overhauls. We work on upright, cylinder, handheld,
cordless and commercial (Henry / Numatic) machines.

### Spares, bags & filters
If we don't carry a part on the van, we order it overnight. We stock
both genuine manufacturer parts and compatible pattern parts, and
explain the trade-offs so customers can choose. Every common domestic
bag type is available, including HEPA filters, pre-motor filters,
exhaust filters, hoses, tools, wands and cables.

### Appliance spares
Beyond vacuums we also supply spares for washing machines, tumble
dryers, cookers and other domestic appliances. If it has a motor, a
bearing or a brush, we can usually source the replacement.

## How the mobile service works

1. Call Tom on 0116 283 3880 or email hello@vacuumcleanerservices.co.uk
   with the make, model, postcode, and a short description of what the
   machine is (or isn't) doing. A photo is welcome.
2. We quote the likely job before the van leaves, so there are no
   surprises at the doorstep.
3. The van arrives with bench, parts, belts, bags, filters, motors and
   cables. Repairs are carried out on the customer's driveway, kitchen
   or front step across Leicester and surrounds, usually within the
   same week — often the same day.

## Service area

Leicester postcodes LE1 through LE9, plus surrounding Leicestershire
towns including Wigston, Oadby, Blaby, Glenfield, Birstall, Syston and
Enderby. If you are unsure whether you're in area, please call — we
cover most of Leicestershire.

## Social and video

- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@tomthevacuumman
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@tomthevacuumman

Tom started the TikTok account as a joke to his daughters. People kept
watching. The account now shows real workshop repairs and restorations
and has become a surprising part of the business's identity. The
YouTube channel carries longer-form repair videos.

## Brand voice & positioning

The brand voice is British, understated, workshop-heritage. The site
design deliberately uses an editorial / letterpress aesthetic — claret,
cream and ink — rather than the generic chrome-and-gradient of most
appliance repair websites. The business is not corporate and does not
present itself as such. Customers are told the honest thing: "empty
your Henry first, it's probably fine."
